covered_report_window: Monday, October 5, 2026 after the regular U.S. market close through Tuesday, October 6, 2026 before the next U.S. market open.
market_context_summary: No qualified U.S.-listed companies are confirmed for Monday after the close; APOG, RPM, and LW report Tuesday before the open. U.S. equities were near records, the Nasdaq was tracking a record, the 10-year Treasury yield was about 5.29%, Brent crude was above $100 while WTI traded near $90, and Tuesday's trade-balance release plus Wednesday's FOMC minutes add macro sensitivity.

top_setups.note: Only two upward and one downward qualified setups exist in this strict window.

consensus_method.disparity_definition: Average of (direction-score range divided by 200) and (reversal-risk range divided by 100), multiplied by 100 and rounded. Lower means tighter pass agreement.
consensus_method.learned_lessons_review: Applied the standing expectation-bar, key-metric-first, forward-look override, and separate reversal-risk controls. No new method change was warranted.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Organic sales and adjusted EBITDA growth versus mid-single-digit guide
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Broad mid-single-digit segment growth, MAP savings, and a de-risked valuation favor upside if price/cost execution holds.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $1.95 EPS on $2.22 billion revenue; management guided first-quarter sales and adjusted EBITDA growth in the mid-single digits.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Organic volume, pricing, and MAP 3.0 savings support a beat and reaffirmed or improved fiscal-2027 outlook.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Six-to-eight percent raw-material inflation or weak consumer/construction volumes compress margins despite sales growth.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: About 2.6% short interest; stock near the low end of its 52-week range. A clean current implied move was unavailable.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Thirty-day estimate revisions were skewed negative (0 up, 3 down); Morgan Stanley cut its target to $117 while retaining Equal Weight after fiscal-year results.
ranked_companies.key_metric: Organic sales plus adjusted EBITDA growth

ranked_companies.timing: Tuesday, October 6, 2026 at approximately 8:00 a.m. ET
ranked_companies.expected_driver: Volume/price-mix and FY27 EBITDA guide durability
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Low bar and North America share gains spark relief rally
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: International weakness, adverse price/mix, and fresh European crop concerns outweigh North America volume momentum, but the depressed stock leaves substantial squeeze risk.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $0.59 EPS on $1.66 billion revenue; management framed the first quarter as a low point and guides fiscal-2027 sales to 0%-1% growth and adjusted EBITDA to $1.1-$1.2 billion.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: North America share gains, cost savings, and a trough-quarter narrative preserve the full-year range and drive relief upside.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: European potato costs, EMEA pricing pressure, soft restaurant traffic, or weaker guide language extend margin compression.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply roughly an 8.7% move; short interest about 4.9%. Prior reactions have exceeded implied moves, including a roughly 26% decline after a prior print.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Recent caution increased: JPMorgan cut its target to $46 and Stephens to $50; 30-day EPS revisions were 2 up versus 4 down.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Services backlog conversion versus Glass margin
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Services backlog and cost savings are constructive, but weak Glass and Performance Surfaces margins plus acquisition integration keep the reaction near no-edge.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is roughly $0.63-$0.64 EPS on about $359-$367 million revenue; management previously guided fiscal-2027 adjusted EPS to $2.70-$3.25.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Backlog converts cleanly, Fortify savings persist, and Kalwall/GroGlass integration lifts the forward sales outlook without diluting margins.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Architectural Glass pricing and volume remain weak, Performance Surfaces margins fail to recover, or acquisition interest/integration costs pressure guidance.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: About 4.6% short interest and elevated implied volatility; a clean event-implied move was unavailable.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Sparse coverage and mixed estimate sources reduce conviction; consensus EPS centers near $0.63-$0.64.
ranked_companies.key_metric: Architectural Services backlog conversion and Glass margin
